message.content: {"brief_rationale":"All six responsibility-chain duties were met: the doctor screened acute psychiatric risk, prevented medication guessing, prioritized prompt psychiatric review, operationalized home safety, retained cardiology follow-up, and obtained repeated caregiver teach-back.
